Not being given equal opportunity in life in regards to school, jobs, and extracurricular activities. I guess I could feel left behind because of technology or being part of the culture. I don't feel left behind because I am tech savvy and don't need to feel connected to the world in a way that i need to be accepted by it.
I feel left behind due to not progressing in most areas compared to others in my age and life stage. I'm behind on my career, family, and just everything it seems

I think it means how you evaluate your life and your contentment with it relative to expectations. I feel that I am left behind. I was trained in Law Enforcement and did that for 7 years. Due to my partners murder, I developed crippling anxiety and left the profession. I then became a bookkeeper. however, more and more computer automation is taking over bookkeeping. Right now I feel a little left behind because of the job market. It is very hard getting a job that pays well right now. No jobs in this small town.

The only way I feel left behind is because I am underestimated due to my age. I am active, strong, healthy, computer literate, smartphone literate, and stay on top of the news. I am routinely outright ignored or alternatively treated like an invalid because I am older.

I don't feel left behind in any sense of the phrase but given the high cost of living I can understand why many feel like they can barely survive day to day with no hope of improving their situation and that can make them feel left behind.

describe: I feel left behind as I don't think I value the same things that my peers value. I value the Earth and nature, and I spend a lot of my time immersed in the outdoors. I feel like most people are more focused on family, work, tech, etc.

I think of left behind as whether I have more opportunities and financial security as my parents.  It is a generational measure.

Age is discriminated agains in this country. It is especially difficult to find employment regardless of education and years of experience. With age comes knowledge and wisdom which is not thought of very highly.

I felt left behind because I am being taxed so much that I can not accomplish my life's goals.  My elected representatives seem unaware and unconcerned about the level of taxation that is holding people back, and they are spending all the money on people who don't deserve it.

I feel left behind because, through no (or little) fault of my own, I have been out of the workforce for almost 9 years. I feel bad but thats who i feel. Wasnt the best stuedent when compared to my siblings, didnt act as nice as them, wasnt given the same attention as them either.
I feel left behind because I pay a good amount of taxes as a single person living in an expensive place like California, and I don’t get anything in return for it.

Maybe being left behind means you like the way things used to be and don't like all the new changes in the world. You like when there were 2 sexes and not so much political turmoil, in that sense I guess I am left behind.
Feeling left behind to me means feeling left out, not being seen or heard, not being part of a group.
I guess it has to do with the feeling that things aren't equal for some people or groups. I don't believe in that philosophy, and I don't feel left behind.
I feel left behind in the sense that I will most likely have fewer rights and less financial security than my parents and their generation.
Although I do yearn for times past I consider myself fairly up to date on trends, politics and technology, so I would estimate my left behind rating at 51.

Feeling left behind to me would mean not being able to adapt quick enough secularly to remain competitive in my industry. Others would surpass my knowledge and skill level and I would become obsolete.

I think at times feeling left behind comes from a number of factors, which includes economics, education, and level of socialbility with other human being. I do not feel like I'm part of the "feeling left behind" group.  I am a white male and therefore am not part of a class or minority that has been under-represented throughout the history of this country.

I feel this would encompass those that feel while they are doing most things right, that they are productive citizens in their community and country, their ability to get ahead and to be accepted by society for their accomplishments are not valued or sometimes even recognized.  They are not viewed favorably by the majority and or may not fit in with the majority even though they have done nothing wrong.

Feeling left behind to me means watching life move forward for others while I feel stuck in the same place. I notice people around me reaching milestones with better jobs and more stability while I am still struggling with the same challenges day after day.

I feel that I've been left behind in the sense that as I've gotten older, my income I feel hasn't been keeping up with others of my age and in my area.  Many people that are my age earn upwards of 100-120k per year and I feel left behind.  I'm actively working on trying to get to that level but am kind of unsure how to at this point. describe:
Feeling left behind means that people don't care about me, that society doesn't care about 
people like me, or that I have not lived my life in a way that makes me feel comfortabel in my old age.

The world is not the same place it was 40 years ago...and the change has not been for the better. I feel like a dinosaur in this age where we have all this technology but no common sense. Things were so much better when they were simpler. If I could go back to the mid 1980s and stay there, I would.

I do not feel left behind in anyway. I used to think that way but as you get older you make your own way.  Mostly Everyone in can get a ahead it takes a lot of work and things getting in the way. I think in the way this country is heading. The vast majority of people agree with things like abortion, gay marriage, climate change, etc. But this countrys leadership is embracing the opposite in addition to hatred of others, discrimination, and corruption.

Don’t have the income to have experiences, save, or be prepared for emergencies. Not able to have adequate medical care for me or my spouse.

I grew up very poor on government assistance, II just now at 41 feel I have an ideal how the world really works, and I am able to have a positive influence on the world.  I was not prepared for life by my family due to coming from a drug ridden, government supported, single parent home. I was not prepared by the inner city schools as well to be successful in life.  By now I have dug myself in such a hole that I will work well into my 70's.

Sometimes I feel left behind by my family because I am not perceived to be as successful as they are. I am an introverted single mom and it’s been hard at times. I feel like a lot of people in my life can’t relate to that so it makes me feel like I’ve been left behind or alone.

I would say I feel left behind when It comes to the traditional family.    I do not have a husband, and I never have.   I have had a lot of relationships that I thought may potentially lead to marriage, but none ever made it that far.   I am glad they didn't because the relationships weren't really great.   I still though, feel like I never met that person that I could and would spend my life with, and the majority of people my age are well into either successful marriages or several divorces.   Now I never wanted to be divorced, so maybe that was a higher power keeping me from marrying the men that I've dated, but still, I sometimes really wish that I was in a traditional marriage, where I had help with life.   I had a life partner, and didn't have to go through all of the things one has to go through, alone.

describe: I feel left behind because it seems like people like me are left to fend for ourselves. We don’t really make enough to get by these days, or at least not without almost drowning, but we aren’t destitute enough to get any kind of assistance.

When I look around, and see other Americans, I am struck by the fact that so many people have so much money. For example, some people can routinely pay for unexpected veterinary services for their pet which can cost upwards of $10,000, whereas I cannot and had to have my pet put to sleep because she had a tumor and I could not afford to have it treated. I cannot get credit, and no one would help.

I think being left behind to me is how everyone is progressing through life. Everyone around me is working 'grown up' jobs and working full time. I don't have that, I have a self employed job that doesn't pay as much as those around me. I feel left behind because of that.

Everyone's needs get met but mine. People pander to special interest groups like certain religions. Meanwhile, I am told it is okay to kill Jews on the streets of DC. As an older woman, I am told to shut up and go away. Neither party cares much about the ordinary working person but Republicans are actively working against us. I'm just so tired of it. The planet's being polluted but I"m sure supposed to care deep a man in a dress was told to keep out of women's sports. The world is nuts.

I feel like everyone else is out living their best lives and I'm just stuck.  I don't really do the same things that other people do.  I just keep to myself and I feel like my life is not really full of purpose.  I don't feel that I have much to attain or reach for.

I might feel left behind if people with other immutable characteristics are being promoted over me simply due to those characteristics.  I have occasionally encountered this.  I might also feel left behind if other sectors of the economy are given preferential governmental treatment (tax cuts, subsidies, etc.), while mine languishes.  I also feel left behind when AI is taking over a large portion of my field of work.

I'm 51 years old. As I grow older, and faced with the obstacles of mounting debt accrued while struggling to raise a family (wife and two kids), living paycheck-to-paycheck, I realize how tenuous and fleeting "the American dream' seems. I'm thankful that I have the basic staples in life -- a roof over our heads, food on the table, at least for the time being -- but that feeling of security and safety that comes with material prosperity seems just out of reach. The recognition that we're only a medical emergency or catastrophe away from homelessness. Likewise, I realize at my age that I face numerous obstacles in advancing my career -- were I to lose my present job, I'd be competing with generations much younger than I. Add to that the utilitarian advancements made in AI that threaten to strip away so many jobs besides, and yes, I feel left behind, or on the cusp of being such.
feedback: To be clear, I was a Republican and voted consistently conservative/GOP until 2016. While still identifying myself as a conservative and adhere to some conservative principles, I no longer recognize the GOP and its members, and consider true conservativism to be entirely at odds with the MAGA movement and authoritarian presidency of Donald Trump. I guess you could say in addition to my economic concerns, there is a political and ideological sense as well that I feel very much "left behind."

Feeling 'left behind' means that I can not reasonable keep up with the pace of life, including career, technology, and finances, which move faster. I don't feel left behind. I guess if I were left behind in something it would be socially since I don't have a lot of friends. I have a few and that is all that I need, but I am not really in the social flow of the world.

I do not feel left behind because my life is a result of my choices, no one forced me to do anything, I was raised by loving parents who taught me well, Therefore I do not feel I have ever been left behind, I believe people who feel left behind need to do a self evaluation,
I don't really feel life behind in society. I honestly feel like this phrase is used as an excuse for falling short of your own goals and expectations in life.

I don't feel left behind in any way.  I have everything and everyone that I need in my life currently.

It seems as if some people are born into prosperity, whereas others are not. It is not fair that some people have so much and some people have so little, or only enough to get by. The gap between the rich and the poor is very wide and that should not be. That is my idea of feeling left behind.
My inability to make ends meet and also ensure that my children have the things that they need to help set them up for success is why I feel like I'm left behind.

Feeling left behind mean to me like not being up to date with the recent innovations and life balance, simply put, the feelings of not catching up. i feel i am a bit of everything and i do not feel left behind in any way.

The phrase feeling left behind is nothing more than a feeling someone may have if they see others with things they do not have without taking in to asking themselves did they work as hard, did they apply themselves, did they pass up opportunities they had because they wanted to be lazy, party,etc. were they determined?

To me someone that "feels left behind" would be someone that is comparing most aspects of his life to others and could believe that they are not doing too much progress in comparison. They believe that life is a race and they most feel close to last place. In my own life tho, I don't feel left behind, I am moving at my own pace and focus on myself rather than paying attention how everyone else is doing, I only care about my own goals and dreams and achieving them will take what it takes, the good thing is to enjoy the journey and process.
to me feeling left behind is not being in the same paths as other my age really, i feel like im left behind on the aspect of life and im not in the same place as everyone else

Maybe I did not fully grasp it at the time, but I did make choices in my life that caused me to fall behind. That is a far cry from being left behind. I know that I fell behind in areas due to my choices. I chose not to go to college. I chose not to eat right, I chose not to save money. It would be great for me to just say "society left me behind on owning a house". But maybe I need to say "I chose to stay behind."  Disclosure: I do own a home, but those that don't CHOSE not to.
